# #444 Tillbaks till gruvan

**Feed**: market-makers  
**Published**: 2026-08-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Market Makers returns from summer break in an upbeat mood as Nordic markets rally and fund inflows to Avanza and Nordnet surge. The hosts review Q2 reports across their holdings — Acast, Hacksaw, Qliro and Reddit remain favoured despite share-price wobbles, while defense name W5 Solutions is dumped after a margin collapse. A revived commodities corner turns bullish on gold and copper miners amid rising rates, central-bank buying and supply constraints.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 ACAST — Acast | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Strong Q2 (30% growth, margins improving, ARPLV +26%); omnichannel/video strategy working; largest holding retained.

#### Reasoning

Acast keeps monetizing better per listen via omnichannel/video and moving up the value chain toward advertisers, not by cramming more ads. Spotify's skip-ad test is a long-term watch item but near-term immaterial given podcasts are a simple download medium. Host keeps it as by-far largest holding.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Spotify's skip-ad feature rolls out broadly and shifts advertisers away
- if listen/view growth turns negative again
- if ARPLV growth stalls

> *"Det är fortfarande mitt särklass största innehav."*

---

### 🟢 HACKS — Hacksaw Gaming | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

EV/EBIT ~9 with 15-28% growth, high profitability, strong geographic diversification limits single-market risk; weak sequential growth likely a game-release timing effect.

#### Reasoning

The soft 3% Q1-to-Q2 growth is plausibly explained by a weaker game-release schedule rather than structural competition. High margins, dividends, and no market above ~10% of revenue give large margin of safety. Host keeps a large position; downside limited, upside optionality on continued operator signings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth structurally slows below ~15% for multiple quarters
- if increased competition clearly erodes market share
- if margins deteriorate

> *"Så jag tycker ändå att aktien fortsatt ser attraktiv ut."*

---

### 🟢 QLIRO — Qliro | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fintech at an inflection point: Q2 revenue +24%, flat costs, operating leverage emerging; short-duration lending lowers dilution risk. Fair-value now but improving unit economics.

#### Reasoning

Revenue accelerating while costs stay flat suggests genuine operating leverage; short-duration BNPL means less bound capital and higher ROE, reducing the chronic rights-issue risk that plagued the stock. Weak take rate is the market's concern. Q3/Q4 critical to confirm the inflection.

#### Sell Triggers

- if another rights issue/dilution comes
- if take rate stays weak or worsens
- if Q3/Q4 fail to confirm operating leverage

> *"Men nu ser man ju att inflektionspunkten har kommit."*

---

### 🟡 RDDT — Reddit | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

8th straight quarter >60% growth, EPS +180%, high incremental margins, zero capex, early monetization; stock -25% on small US DAU dip and Google/AI referral fears.

#### Reasoning

US daily-active-user dip (~300k) is small and likely temporary/seasonal; low AI-content share signals higher-quality posts and durable value to Google. Weekly and logged-out users up, so traffic isn't collapsing. Removing logged-in/out disclosure is a mild negative. Valuation ~20x FCF 2026 reasonable for a one-of-a-kind asset.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US daily active users keep declining in Q3/Q4
- if Google referrals collapse from AI summaries
- if monetization growth decelerates on real demand weakness

> *"Så jag äger fortfarande den här aktien."*

---

### 🔴 W5 — W5 Solutions | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 80%

Q2 revenue +66% but gross margin collapsed 65%→42% into a loss; opaque disclosure and unexplained SEK17m acquisition costs; poor cost control and scalability.

#### Reasoning

Despite strong order intake and a favourable defense-spending backdrop, the company's own execution — cost efficiency and scalability — is inadequate, shown by the margin collapse and a loss. Weak conference-call transparency compounds the concern. Host sold entire position; thesis broken.

#### Sell Triggers

- if gross margin recovers durably toward 60%+
- if management explains cost drivers and improves disclosure
- if profitability returns while revenue growth holds

> *"Så jag har sålt allt."*

---

### ⛔ NELLY — Nelly | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Stock down ~70% from winter highs, two weak quarters, and now loss of a strong CEO; operations still ok but market had priced in more. Hosts hold no shares.

#### Reasoning

Operationally the company still performs, but expectations were set too high and the departure of a well-regarded CEO amid a share collapse adds uncertainty and bad timing. Hosts exited after Q1 and remain out, treating it as a 'bad news keeps coming' situation.

#### Sell Triggers

- clear operational re-acceleration under new CEO
- stabilization after successive weak quarters
- valuation reset that prices in the bad news

> *"Nu känns det som att ingenting mer kan gå dåligt för det här bolaget."*

---

### 🟡 SAAB-B — Saab | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Recovered while smaller defense names lagged; winning submarine orders and positioned higher in the value chain as procurement moves to complex systems.

#### Reasoning

As the defense rearmament cycle progresses from simple goods (ammo, vehicles) to complex systems (jets, submarines), Saab sits well in the value chain and has won submarine orders, unlike early-value-chain small caps. Cited positively versus struggling smaller peers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defense procurement cycle stalls
- if order intake weakens
- if execution/margins disappoint

> *"Nej, Saab har ju ändå återhämtat sig."*

---
